## The question

[USPS Postnet barcodes](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5591/usps-postnet-barcodes), asked by [Kent](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/928/kent) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-18; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> After searching on-and-off for several weeks I haven't found an answer to this. Is there a LaTeX package to generate USPS zip+4 barcodes on an envelope?
:::

The [envlab](http://www.ctan.org/tex-archive/macros/latex/contrib/envlab/) package does envelopes, labels, and barcodes.
